what: Optimised import test with ?assets=0 against the original baseline (gate-proof-v2/baseline), RTX 4050, 1920x1080, 4 views x 4 languages, two runs. Each run loads the baseline twice (before and after the test page).
result: Mid-pass runs (below): ink, memory and anime 0 differing pixels. Final code: 0 on a warm load, but a first, cold load showed 618 px at 1/255 in one ink frame (see final_code, open_item). Ink night: the baseline differs from itself between loads.
pre_existing_nondeterminism: Only in ink night (language 3), only in the upper sky where the stars are drawn. Present between two loads of the unmodified baseline. Not investigated further tonight.
harness_faults_found_and_fixed: Pointer parallax: Chrome sends mousemove when content under a resting OS cursor changes, which panned the camera on whichever page happened to get one. lib.mjs now centres the mouse after each load.
Idle clock: the figure's idle animation accumulated time between captures. __set now accepts idleT to pin it.
Loading fade: the loading page fades over 360 ms; firstcheck.mjs waits for it to be removed.
Loading fade on warm loads: open() now waits for the loading page to be removed.
Capture-mode re-render at time 0 after background compilation raced with tests; it now uses the last capture's time.
Capture mode ignores pointer parallax entirely and logs pointer events (1-3 arrived per capture run, confirming the cause).
regression_found_and_fixed: Statue colour in paintAnime was first written with ternaries over shared constants, which changed compiler constant folding for every surface: 34 pixels differed by 1/255 in anime. Rewritten as a separate statue-only branch; anime is now 0.

warm_load.test_vs_baseline: 0 in ink, memory and anime; 2 px at 1/255 in ink night (baseline vs itself: 1)

cold_load.test_vs_baseline: arch_0 (ink): 618 px at 1/255, reproducible on the first, cold load only; arch_3: 1 px

final_code.first_program_vs_full_ink: 0 px in two runs; 992 and 1003 px at 1/255 in two others
final_code.open_item: 1/255 differences only in frames drawn by cold-compiled programs. Harness causes ruled out (pointer, loading fade, idle clock, capture re-render race, mask contamination). Suspected: compiled shader binary differs between cold compile and cache. Unverified.
